_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. This file is regenerated at build time by scripts/fetch-listings.mjs from the CatchDoms API, and committed back by CI so the data is auditable and the daily schedule stays alive. It must NEVER hold hand-written placeholder domains again: from 2026-06-04 to 2026-11-10 the fallback path in that script resurrected a committed sample, so /tlds/com/ and /tlds/uk/ served INVENTED domain names in public for five months and the home page's headline total was inflated by about a third. An empty file means a failed fetch produces no page at all, which is honest; a seeded file means a failed fetch produces a lie.
